scope: credential-free model catalog drift surface counts
change: The immutable aggregate driftCounts summary now includes distinct affected kind and adapter counts, derived from the same verified catalog comparison as the detailed drift mappings.

semantics.affectedKinds: number of distinct previous/current model kinds represented by structural model drift
semantics.affectedAdapters: number of distinct previous/current adapter identifiers represented by structural model drift
semantics.sourceRevisionOnly: source-revision-only drift reports zero affected kinds and adapters
semantics.unchanged: identical verified catalogs report zero affected kinds and adapters
